interface.name: infinity_session_v1

description.summary: session lock notices for the shell

interface.description: Tells the shell when the session starts to lock and when it is unlocked again, so the menu bar can turn into the lock screen's status row and back (Malaysia ADR 0074). It grants nothing and carries no secret, so every client may bind it.

event.name: locking
event.description: Sent when a client asks to lock the session. The compositor hides every other surface over duration milliseconds; then it shows the lock screen. A duration of 0 means there is no transition.

arg.name: duration
arg.summary: length of the fade, in milliseconds
